description: Cancel every queued and scheduled task in the local queue at once; for a single task use cancel_task. Use when: the user says "cancel everything" or "clear the queue". Do not use to drop one task or to end a repeating series (use cancel_task, with series=true for a series). Behavior: marks each pending task cancelled; running, submitted and finished tasks stay as they are; no network or login. A repeating task skips this occurrence and its next one is queued, so a second call cancels that one too. Returns: "Cancelled N of M task(s)." and one error line per task that could not be cancelled.

status.description: Cancel only tasks in one state: 'queued' (no window picked yet) or 'scheduled' (window picked). Omit to cancel both.

name: cancel_all
